Hi there! I need some help with a few exchanges and a cancellation. I recently placed an order that included a bicycle, a jigsaw puzzle, and a camera. I’d like to exchange the bicycle for a larger frame size for my kid, and swap the jigsaw puzzle for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces—if possible, I’d prefer an animal theme over art. Also, I want to exchange the camera for one with a slightly lower resolution, but I’d like to keep the other features the same.

And, in a separate order, I need to cancel a skateboard. Can you help me with all of that?
Sure! My name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order, but hopefully my name and zip code will be enough.
I’m sorry, I don’t have the order IDs handy right now. Is there another way you can look them up? Maybe by the items or by the date? I placed both orders pretty recently.

Yes, that’s all correct! For the exchanges, if there’s any price difference or refund, I’d prefer to use my other card instead of the one used for the original purchase.

And for the skateboard cancellation, the reason is “no longer needed.” Let me know if you need anything else from me!

Yes, I agree with all those actions. Please use the card ending in 8484 for any price differences or refunds related to the exchanges.

Let me know if you need anything else from me!
No, that covers everything I needed. Thanks for your help!
